architecture.mechanism: Thermal overload destabilizes lubricant-film integrity leading to severe tribological deterioration in cam-tappet interfaces.
architecture.intervention: Implement enhanced cooling system protocols and mandate reduced idle duration limits during the initial 400-mile break-in period to prevent localized thermal accumulation.
architecture.expected_effect: Maintenance of stable boundary-lubrication conditions preventing premature wear and eliminating tapping sounds in low-mileage valvetrains.
architecture.falsification_test: Operate test engines under impaired cooling and prolonged idle conditions for 400 miles; mechanism is falsified if oil analysis shows no depletion of alkaline reserve and SEM evaluation reveals no severe non-uniform camshaft wear.
